message.content:
The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is the protoplanet **HD 100546 b**.  
It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly **2.5 × Jupiter’s radius** (about 180,000 km).  Because it is still forming, its mass is not precisely known, but it is certainly larger than any planet in our own Solar System.
